_comment: Private-server gacha banners (our own design; the original per-banner medal lists were server-only and are lost). Each banner: lots = list of {count, rates} where rates maps medal rarity (1-6 stars) to a weight; pool = 'standard' (regular character medals, series 1x-3x), 'illustrated' (4x/14x specials), 'organization' (13x), or an explicit medal id list (a 'store' banner: one id = buy that medal). unlockQuests = story quests cleared before it shows. payType 1 = Jewels (free Jewels are spent first). Rates for 3-5 stars and the 10-pull 5-star guarantee come from the 2016 drawMedalType rows; 6-star odds and unlock points are ours to tune.

banners.name: Premium Draw x10
banners.description: 10 Medals, at least one 5★ or better!
